name: Myth and fact
look_note: A tested run that pins this skeleton keeps the pillars look unless --look names another.

sections.hero: Dek: the beliefs that stop readers, checked against the facts.
sections.items: Each item: the myth or claim as people say it, then what the verified facts say, then why it matters.
sections.faq: Any belief with no verified fact to answer it goes nowhere -- drop it, never guess.
sections.closing: Recap three facts that held up.

items.heading_hint: A belief about installation or power
A belief about how much room it takes
A belief that a key feature always costs extra
A belief about running or upkeep cost -- only with a verified claim
A belief about delivery or returns

voice: Calm and corrective, second person; never mocks the reader.
compliance: Every number, price, spec or outcome needs a verified claim_id; a hint is never a fact.
No health or outcome promise for the product; a health statement cites the study and its population.
A myth with no verified fact to answer it is dropped, not answered from general knowledge.
writer_brief: Myth or claim, then the verified fact. Facts must carry claim_ids. Short.
